name: Jack the Ripper
summary: **Jack the Ripper** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:TGA Genetics|TGA Genetics]] (Subcool's The Dank), an outcross of [[jacks-cleaner|Jack's Cleaner]] with a [[space-queen|Space Queen]] male. It was Subcool's first outcross beyond the Jack's Cleaner line, intended to build on it using Space Queen genetics. Deeper ancestry runs through [[jack-herer|Jack Herer]], [[northern-lights|Northern Lights]], and [[romulan|Romulan]].

sources.title: Jack the Ripper (SubCool's The Dank)
sources.note: Breeder-submitted lineage (Jack's Cleaner x Space Queen), flowering time, and history as Subcool's first Jack's Cleaner outcross.
